name: between
description: 基于 SillyTavern 角色引擎的本机聊天应用与管理控制台

scripts.typecheck: npm run setup && npm run typecheck --workspace @between/admin && node scripts/check-modules.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @between/role-engine && npm run test --workspace @between/server && npm run test:plan --workspace @between/server && npm run test:local --workspace @between/server && npm run test --workspace @between/admin && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser --workspace @between/admin && node tests/browser/chat.mjs && node tests/browser/oauth.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
